page.layout: One printed title page; centred lines from top to bottom; an woodcut device (anchor with serpent) in the middle; imprint lines below the device. A library stamp at the right is not transcribed.

l.i: Ab Auctore recognita, emendata, aucta, & Latinè ex Gallico reddita.

main_text.l: Adjecti sunt de simili argumento duo insignes THEO-DORETI, vetustissimi ex quinto Christianismi sæculo Episcopi, sermones, sive libelli.
ROM. X. 17. Fides ex auditu; auditus autem per verbum CHRISTI.
Sumpt. I. Antonii & Samuelis de Tournes.

page.notes: Woodcut device of an anchor with a serpent, between the title lines and the imprint; a library oval stamp at the right, not transcribed. Some words in the title are doubtful in the scan: "Nòvàm" and "Adjecti" read as printed; "vetustissimi" as printed.
